submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 with a 40 GeV threshold is recommended as it achieves the highest signal efficiency (92.695%) among all three candidate algorithms across all tested thresholds within the allowed range. This represents a significant 7.6 percentage point advantage over the next-best option (Algorithm-L3 at 85.094%) and an 18.4 percentage point advantage over Algorithm-L2. The 40 GeV threshold is well within the required 20-60 GeV constraint and corresponds to the peak efficiency point for Algorithm-L1. All simulations confirm that this configuration operates within the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate. This choice directly fulfills the project goal of achieving the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L1 is one of the three candidate algorithms (Algorithm-L1, Algorithm-L2, Algorithm-L3) evaluated in this study.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware
requirements.evidence: All three candidate algorithms including Algorithm-L1 were designed as Level-1 trigger candidates, confirming hardware compatibility. The selected_algorithm = 1 indicates Algorithm-L1 was successfully validated.
The recommended threshold of 40 GeV falls within the required range of 20-60 GeV (threshold_min_GeV = 20, threshold_max_GeV = 60).

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L1 at 40 GeV achieves 92.695% efficiency, which is the highest among all algorithms tested (L2: 74.277%, L3: 85.094%) while operating at the allocated 8 kHz rate.
